Excellent place
Aug 2026 • Couples
We arrived without a reservation and, although the restaurant was quite full, they welcomed us with great courtesy, finding us a table immediately.

The atmosphere is not particularly elegant, but do not expect a simple tavern either: the place is pleasant, the service is very attentive, and above all, the menu offers an interesting and refined selection of traditional Vietnamese dishes.

We started with the Crab Spring Rolls, continuing with Bún Chả Hà Nội and Grilled Beef in Bamboo Tubes. We also added the Morning Glory, one of the vegetables we learned to appreciate during our trip to Vietnam. All the dishes were very generous, well-prepared, and above all, presented impeccably.

To drink, we had water and a coconut beverage. I would like to point out, for transparency, that we were also offered a small gift in exchange for an immediate review, a practice that I personally find a bit peculiar.

We spent about €18 per person and ate really very well. Considering quality, portion size, dish presentation, and service, the price-quality ratio is truly excellent.

An excellent solution for trying various traditional Vietnamese dishes in a more refined setting than street food, without spending significant amounts. Definitely recommended.
I would add that you can pay with a credit card (not a given in Hanoi).

Underwhelming
Jul 2026 • Couples
Underwhelming to say the least. The dining area lacks atmosphere and style. 

It’s in a very central location which is handy when wandering the streets but I wouldn’t make this a place to go out of one’s way to reach.

Very nice for an appetiser, we had the crispy crab spring rolls. Very well cooked and a good portion for sharing. Unfortunately the mains were a disappointment. Gelatinous noodles in a clump and overcooked prawns was not what was expected from previous reviews.

Staff were friendly and helpful but lacked training in the industry. Many staff loitering around tables. 

Pity but may have been an off experience

What truly made the evening exceptional was our server, Will. He was attentive, friendly, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful experience. His recommendations and hospitality added a personal touch that made our visit memorable.

If you’re looking for excellent food and exceptional service in Hanoi, I highly recommend The East. We will definitely return on our next visit.

Tremendous Vietnamese food! Highly recommend
May 2026 • Family
My wife and I had a wonderful time at The East. Hanoi is a challenging city to decide where to eat, given many recommendations on the internet are to stay casual. The East was the perfect blend of nicer / more upscale but not being too over the top (e.g. tasting menu).

This was my wife's first meal in Vietnam, and I'll never forget her reactions to the flavors of the food. We ate at several other high quality restaurants in Hanoi (including staying at the Sofitel Metropole) and agreed The East's food had the best culinary execution and demonstration of Vietnamese food. 

The location of the restaurant is also great. After dinner my wife and I embarked on a nice stroll around the Old Quarter.

Shoutout to Cindy, Vy, Beenie, and Amee for their service! We felt very taken care of.
